title: debark events v1
description: debark.events/v1 - structured build/install events, written as if an auditor will read them in five years: objects, not log strings. This schema's top level validates evidence.json (the Document: a header plus every recorded event), written at the bundle root. Each element of its events array, and each line of an NDJSON --json-events stream, independently validates against $defs/Event, which is self-describing (it carries its own "schema" field) so a single streamed line can be validated without the Document wrapper.

created_at.description: When this evidence file was finalised, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

context.description: Run identity: tool version, edition, backend, build host kind, and an operator identity only when the operator chose to record one. Never a machine fingerprint; never collected without the operator asking. Deliberately open-ended: keys vary by run.

events.description: Every event recorded during the run, in emission order.

schema.description: Fixed schema identifier, repeated on every event so a single NDJSON line is self-describing.

ts.description: When this event occurred, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

type.description: The event kind. This list is additive-only: a future version may add a type but will never repurpose one of these.

msg.description: Short human sentence; machine consumers should read attrs, not this.

attrs.description: Type-specific fields. Every value is JSON-encodable and must never contain a secret. Deliberately open-ended: shape depends on type.
